purpose: Teach: つけ加え/まるまる/たんに/思いのほか/ガタガタ/やっとこ/おのずから/じっさい

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんが絵に星を一つつけ加えてあげる
lines.en: Sho, let me add a star to your drawing.
lines.style: Warm, gentle offer. Soft attack. Leans in with quiet affection. The tone of someone who notices what matters to a child and moves slowly toward it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、絵をまるまる新しいページに描いたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I drew the whole picture on a fresh page.
lines.style: Small voice carrying real pride. Careful articulation — wants to be understood. Slight lift at the end, seeking her reaction without demanding it.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんもたんに緊張してただけよ
lines.en: Sho, I was just nervous too, you know.
lines.style: Honest, a little surprised at herself for admitting it. Thoughtful pace. Meets his eyes. The moment an older sibling stops performing and becomes real.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、ピアノ発表会、思いのほか上手くいったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, the piano recital went better than I thought it would.
lines.style: Steady, almost wondering. No bravado — genuine relief coloring the words. Slight emphasis on 'better,' like he's still processing the success.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、ベンチがガタガタしてるから気を付けてね
lines.en: Sho, be careful — this bench is wobbly.
lines.style: Quick, protective instinct. Matter-of-fact but not unkind. The practicality of someone watching over a child, not lecturing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、やっとこ自転車に乗れるようになったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I finally learned to ride my bike.
lines.style: Bright lift on 'finally.' Small voice still, but with a new lightness. The pride of a child who worked through something hard and wants her to know.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんは「おのずから絵は上達する」って
lines.en: Sho, I believe that art improves on its own, you know.
lines.style: Reflective, almost philosophical in the way older siblings can be. Soft, steady delivery. She's sharing something she truly believes, not a platitude.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、じっさいメイ姉さんと過ごす時間が好き
lines.en: Mei-sis, I actually really like spending time with you.
lines.style: Quiet, earnest. No performance. Direct gaze. The kind of simple truth a child speaks when he feels safe. Slight vulnerability underneath.
